name: Reduce Network Background Interruptions
description: Prevents unnecessary network resets and event noise
commands:
netsh int ip set global dhcpmediasense=disabled
netsh int ip set global mediasenseeventlog=disabled
netsh int ipv6 set global dhcpmediasense=disabled
revert22H2:
netsh int ip set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
netsh int ip set global mediasenseeventlog=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
revert23H2:
netsh int ip set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
netsh int ip set global mediasenseeventlog=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
revert24H2:
netsh int ip set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
netsh int ip set global mediasenseeventlog=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
revertCommands:
netsh int ip set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
netsh int ip set global mediasenseeventlog=enabled
netsh int ipv6 set global dhcpmediasense=enabled
